entities.name: Francisco Peña
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Francisco Antonio Peña is a Dominican-American professional baseball catcher for the Piratas de Campeche of the Mexican League. He has previously played in Major League Baseball (MLB) for the Kansas City Royals, Baltimore Orioles and St. Louis Cardinals. He has also played in the Chinese Professional Baseball League (CPBL) for the CTBC Brothers.
